remagic.configuration.title: ReMagic Configs
remagic.gui.diary.title: Diary
remagic.gui.diary.about_text:
Welcome to the ReMagic Diary!

Here are gathered the secrets of the world's hidden energies, ancient rituals, and artifacts.

Select a category on the right to begin your journey.
remagic.gui.diary.default_category_desc:
This section contains all known knowledge and mechanics on this subject.

Select an entry from the list on the right to open its pages.
remagic.gui.category.basics.name: Basics of Magic
remagic.gui.category.basics.desc:
Basic knowledge and essential tools of the magical arts.

Select an entry from the list on the right to study it.
remagic.gui.category.rituals.name: Rituals
remagic.gui.category.rituals.desc:
Ancient rituals that bend elements and transmute matter.

Select a ritual from the list on the right to inspect its components.
remagic.gui.entry.mana_crystals.name: Mana Crystals
remagic.gui.entry.mana_crystals.page1:
Mana crystals are the primary source of magical energy in the world of ReMagic.

They form deep underground near clusters of amethyst and redstone.
remagic.gui.entry.mana_crystals.page2:
Mining these crystals requires an iron pickaxe or better.

Beware: an unstable crystal may release raw energy upon breaking!
remagic.gui.entry.mana_crystals.page3: A purified crystal can be placed in an Infusion Altar to recharge wands and arcane capacitors.
remagic.gui.entry.mana_crystals.page4: In the future, crafting recipes and altar animations will appear here.
remagic.gui.entry.diary.name: Diary
remagic.gui.entry.diary.page1: The Diary is my main companion in arcane research. Here I will document all the magical knowledge I gather.
remagic.gui.entry.diary.craft_desc: To craft a Diary, combine a regular book with red dye in a crafting grid.
remagic.gui.entry.diary.image_desc: The diary cover is adorned with enchanted runes and leather binding.
remagic.gui.entry.infusion_altar.name: Infusion Altar
remagic.gui.entry.infusion_altar.page1: The infusion altar is used to infuse common items with pure magical essence.
remagic.gui.entry.infusion_altar.page2: Place an item on the central pedestal and arrange crystals in a circle around it.
remagic.gui.entry.purification_ritual.pa: The purification ritual removes impurities and boosts metal yields from raw ore.
Ignite fire on basalt blocks around the runic circle to begin transmutation.
